messages:
sre-oncall: Alert — multiple customer escalations for hosted inference in ap-southeast1 (region apse1). Seeing 502/504 spikes and API timeouts starting ~04:20 UTC. Grafana shows packet loss ~0.8-1.6% on the egress edge router toward TransitProviderA and sustained cross-AZ latency between apse1-a and apse1-b. Opening thread to coordinate.
netops: on it. I'm seeing BGP AS path churn to TransitProviderA for the apse1 POPs — routes flip between our primary and a backup path every ~30-60s. Provider confirmed planned maintenance but admit impact larger than expected. Gathered bgp logs, will paste shortly.
eng-runtime: customer reports show LLM inference requests returning 502 gateway errors from our API gateway. Backend containers are healthy; request hits don't reach model-serving 100% of the time. Likely transit-level loss causing retries/timeouts at the gateway.
support-esk: two active customer tickets: AcmeCorp (#12345) and TutorAI (#12346). Both include curl traces showing 502 with body "upstream prematurely closed connection". They report spikes started ~04:15 UTC and are seeing elevated latency and failed requests in retries.
customer-success: pushing ACME and TutorAI updates every 15m. They're asking for ETA and mitigation. They want note for status page.
netops: bgp snippet:
```
Apr 12 04:22:11 bgpd[123]: UPDATE from 203.0.113.10: AS_PATH changed: 64512 64496 -> 64512 64423 64496
Apr 12 04:22:42 bgpd[123]: *NEIGHBOR* flap: holdtime expired, session reset
```
Also mtr shows packet loss to transit next-hop 203.0.113.1: 3-4% with high jitter.
eng-runtime: repro steps from support curl logs:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gptx-13b","input":"test"}' --max-time 10
* Connection timed out after 10000 milliseconds
< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"upstream prematurely closed connection"}
```
sre-oncall: captured tcpdump from edge (apse1-edge-2) around incident window. Repeated retransmits and duplicate ACKs, then socket resets on 10.10.20.45:443 -> 203.0.113.1:port. Snippet:
```
16:22:15.123456 IP 10.10.20.45.443 > 203.0.113.1.52345: Flags [P.], seq 1234:1678, ack 4321, win 64240
16:22:15.223789 IP 10.10.20.45.443 > 203.0.113.1.52345: Flags [RST]
```
netops: opened ticket with TransitProviderA (TPA-8901). Logged support case and asked for emergency route pin to reduce flaps. Also enabling our secondary provider via emergency policy in 3m.
eng-runtime: as mitigation, I'll push emergency routing policy to prefer TransitProviderB for apse1 for HTTP/443 egress and enable gateway-level retry/backoff tuning for 5xx from 2 retries -> 4 with exponential jitter. Doing canary update now.
support-esk: instructing customers to fallback regionally — added note: "If you can, switch to region eu-west1 until ap-southeast1 stabilizes". We provided curl/SDK snippet to change region param.
deploybot: Canary rollout started for gateway retry config (canary=5% apse1 traffic) at 04:28:10 UTC.
eng-runtime: canary looks okay so far, 5xx rate on canary reduced from 11% -> 3% after routing change. Rolling to 25%.
customer-success: AcmeCorp confirmed partial recovery after switching to eu-west1; TutorAI still seeing intermittent failures when pinned to ap-southeast1.
netops: TPA acknowledged noisy interface and scheduled immediate fix; reported high utilization on their transit link causing microbursts and BGP session resets. They expect stabilization in 45-90 minutes and will provide updates in ticket TPA-8901.
sre-oncall: Action items:
- netops: continue to push provider ticket and monitor BGP (owner: @netops)
- eng-runtime: finish rollout of routing failover + gateway retry tuning (owner: @eng-runtime)
- support-esk/customer-success: continue customer comms and advise region failover (owners)
- ops: collect pcap and forward to provider if they request (owner: @sre-oncall)
We'll reconvene in 30m unless resolved earlier.
support-esk: adding journaling to tickets with reproducer steps and example request IDs for our logs: reqid=ap-20240412-0a1b2c3d.
eng-runtime: note — temporarily lowering model verbosity for customers pinned to apse1 to reduce token emission and retry surface; will revert post-incident.
sre-oncall: Last check-in 04:39 UTC: 5xx error rate in apse1 down to 1.2%, packet loss reduced to ~0.2% after routing flip. netops, leave provider patching in progress. Closing once provider confirms BGP stable for 1h.
netops: provider confirmed planned fix applied at 04:55 UTC in ticket TPA-8901. We'll monitor for 1h before fully removing emergency routing. I'll post final update.
customer-success: informing customers that we observed provider-side microbursts affecting ap-southeast1 and that we routed traffic to secondary provider; recommendations and postmortem to follow. :white_check_mark:
